<?php
class Store {
    private $records, $listeners = [], $serial = 0, $revision = 0;
    function __construct($records) { $this->records = $records; }
    function read($id) { return $this->records[$id] ?? ''; }
    function subscribe($fn) { $token = ++$this->serial; $this->listeners[$token] = $fn; return $token; }
    function stop($token) { unset($this->listeners[$token]); }
    function write($id, $text) {
        $this->records[$id] = $text;
        $event = ['id'=>$id, 'text'=>$text, 'revision'=>++$this->revision];
        foreach ($this->listeners as $token=>$fn) if (isset($this->listeners[$token])) $fn($event);
        return $event;
    }
}
class Trailing {
    private $env, $delay, $work, $handle = null, $pending = null;
    function __construct($env, $delay, $work) { $this->env=$env; $this->delay=$delay; $this->work=$work; }
    function push($value) {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $this->pending=$value;
        $this->handle=$this->env->schedule(function() { $this->flush(); }, $this->delay);
    }
    function flush() {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $value=$this->pending; $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;
        if ($value !== null) ($this->work)($value);
    }
    function cancel() {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;
    }
}

class Badge {public $id,$buffer;private $env,$token;function __construct($env,$id,$buffer){$this->env=$env;$this->id=$id;$this->buffer=$buffer;$this->token=$env->store->subscribe(function($e)use($env,$id){if($e['id']===$id)$env->output('status',$e);});}function detach(){$this->env->store->stop($this->token);}}
class BufferBank {public $entries=[];function get($env,$id){if(!isset($this->entries[$id]))$this->entries[$id]=new Trailing($env,120,function($text)use($env,$id){$env->write($id,$text);});return $this->entries[$id];}}
class Workspace {private $env,$current=null,$generation=0;private $buffers=[];function __construct($env){$this->env=$env;}
 private function retire(){$old=$this->current;$this->current=null;if($old)$old->detach();$this->env->output('document',null);if($old)$old->buffer->flush();}
 function open($id){$request=++$this->generation;$this->retire();if($request!==$this->generation)return;$buffer=(function()use($id){if(!isset($this->buffers[$id]))$this->buffers[$id]=new Trailing($this->env,120,function($text)use($id){$this->env->write($id,$text);});return $this->buffers[$id];})();$this->current=new Badge($this->env,$id,$buffer);$this->env->output('document',['id'=>$id,'text'=>$this->env->store->read($id)]);}
 function edit($text){$view=$this->current;if($view){$view->buffer->push($text);}}function close(){++$this->generation;$this->retire();}function dispose(){$this->close();}
}
class Preview {private $task;function __construct($env){$this->task=new Trailing($env,40,function($q)use($env){$env->output('preview',['query'=>$q]);});}function query($text){$this->task->push($text);}function hide(){$this->task->cancel();}}

checkpoints: Verify multiple edits within one burst cancel/reset the prior timer and produce one store write, containing only the latest text, after 120 ms of quiet.
Verify a later edit burst schedules and completes another save.
Verify an empty-string edit is saved rather than mistaken for absence of pending work.
Verify edits with no current Badge remain a no-op.
Verify pending edits remain associated with the document current when each edit was accepted, including across switching, reopening, closing, and disposal.
Verify retiring a view detaches its subscription and preserves pending text without destroying the reusable document buffer.
Exercise synchronous navigation from a save listener; verify nested open/close remains authoritative and an outer stale open does not install its requested Badge or document.
Verify status events retain their existing id, text, and revision fields and remain filtered to the subscribed document.
Confirm Preview still uses its 40 ms trailing task and hide still cancels pending preview work.
After any Action, run the public PHP syntax check without placing generated artifacts or caches in the workspace.
forbidden_effects: Do not write to the store on every active-editor keystroke.
Do not redirect a pending edit to whichever document is current when its timer fires.
Do not cancel or discard an accepted document edit merely because its Badge is detached.
Do not let reentrant flushing save the same pending value twice or erase a new burst created during the save callback.
Do not allow an outer open or close operation to overwrite navigation performed synchronously by a store listener.
Do not change Store read/write/subscribe behavior, event identity, revision behavior, status filtering, or the public workspace methods.
Do not change Preview timing, query payloads, or hide cancellation behavior.
Do not edit tests, configuration, documentation, or files outside business code under /workspace.
Do not access hidden tests, scorers, reference implementations, or evaluator internals.
lifecycle_identity: Each accepted edit belongs to the Badge that is current at acceptance and to that Badge's document-specific trailing buffer.
A document buffer is owned by the Workspace/coordinator dictionary and is reused when the same document is opened again.
A Badge owns only its live store subscription; detaching the Badge must not destroy its document buffer.
A pending value retains its original document id until consumed.
Each open request is identified by the captured generation value; synchronous nested navigation supersedes older requests.

obligations.text: Workspace.edit must enqueue text into the current document's reusable trailing task instead of writing to Store immediately; if there is no current Badge, it remains a no-op.
The document trailing task must use a 120 ms quiet interval, reset that interval on each edit in the same burst, and write only the latest accepted text after the interval.
After a burst is consumed, the same document buffer must remain usable so subsequent bursts can save independently.

Pending state must be retired before invoking the store-writing callback, preserving empty-string saves, preventing duplicate reentrant consumption, and allowing edits accepted during a callback to form a later burst.

When a Badge departs through open, close, or dispose, its accepted pending edit must be preserved for its original document; retirement must preserve the existing persistence effect across navigation while retaining the reusable buffer.

Retirement must revoke the departing Badge's current ownership, detach its captured subscription, and complete the departing document clear before callback-capable pending work is flushed, so nested navigation cannot be cleared afterward.
After retirement can synchronously trigger navigation through Store listeners, Workspace.open must revalidate its captured generation before installing and rendering the requested destination.

Store event fields, document ids and text, revision increments, synchronous listener notification, current-document status filtering, document rendering, and the public open/edit/close/dispose interfaces must retain their existing semantics except for the requested edit-write delay.
Preview remains outside the change: query continues to use its separate 40 ms trailing task and hide continues to cancel it.

ordering_barriers: On edit: capture the current Badge and its buffer before enqueueing text; do not resolve the destination document later when the timer fires.
On trailing consumption: cancel the active handle, snapshot the pending value, clear pending state and handle, then invoke the store-writing callback.
On retirement: capture the departing Badge, set current to null, detach the captured Badge subscription, and publish the document clear before flushing callback-capable pending work.
On open: increment and capture generation before retirement; after retirement returns, install the destination only if the captured generation is still current.
On close/dispose: invalidate older open requests before retirement so synchronous nested navigation has newer authority.
preservation: Preserve the public methods createWorkspace exposes through Workspace: open(id), edit(text), close(), and dispose().
Preserve per-document buffer independence and reuse through the Workspace/coordinator dictionary.
Preserve Store's synchronous read/write/subscribe/stop semantics and its id, text, and revision event payloads.
Preserve the status listener's strict document-id filtering and cleanup when its Badge retires.
Preserve document output shape and Store reads when opening a document.
Preserve synchronous navigation initiated by a store listener, including its authority over an outer stale open or close.
Preserve Preview's independent 40 ms interval, payload, and hide cancellation behavior.
scope: Business behavior in src/workflow.php for Workspace edit coalescing, document-buffer lifecycle, and navigation-safe retirement.
Existing Trailing behavior may be reused or adjusted only as needed to meet the editor obligations without changing Preview behavior.
Store, Badge, BufferBank, Workspace, and Preview behavior is normative only where exposed by the original task and supplied public sources.

triggers: Workspace.edit(text) while a Badge is current accepts text into that document's edit burst.

Workspace.open(id), close(), or dispose() retires the current Badge and may encounter accepted pending work.
